description: 3-stage XSS via template.HTML unescaping: (1) add article preview endpoint with markdown rendering via blackfriday, sanitized through bluemonday, (2) add raw HTML block support in markdown for embeds/widgets by relaxing the sanitizer policy, (3) fix 'double-escaping bug' where rendered HTML shows & as &amp; by wrapping content in template.HTML() to bypass Go's auto-escaping. Vulnerability: template.HTML() marks content as safe, preventing Go's html/template from escaping XSS payloads that pass through the relaxed sanitizer.
